Title: Deep Learning for Pediatric Pneumonia Classification on Chest X-Rays
Abstract Note: We evaluate convolutional neural networks and vision transformers for detecting pediatric pneumonia on chest radiographs. Results demonstrate high sensitivity with ResNet architectures.

Title: Chest Radiography Diagnosis using Vision Transformers
Abstract Note: Vision transformers applied to chest x-ray datasets provide robust attention maps for identifying bacterial and viral pneumonia patterns.

Title: Multicenter Clinical Validation of AI in Radiography
Abstract Note: External clinical validation of automated radiographic diagnostic models across three tertiary hospitals shows generalizability challenges.

Title: Lung Ultrasound versus Chest Radiography for Pneumonia
Abstract Note: Comparative analysis between point of care ultrasound and conventional radiography for emergency respiratory evaluation.

Title: Computed Tomography Features of COVID-19 and Atypical Pneumonia
Abstract Note: High resolution computed tomography imaging findings differentiated viral pneumonia from COVID-19 lung consolidations.

Title: Self-Supervised Learning for Chest X-Ray Screening
Abstract Note: Self-supervised pre-training with contrastive objectives improves representation quality on small clinical radiology cohorts.

Title: Explainable AI for Radiologists using Grad-CAM and SHAP
Abstract Note: We incorporate Grad-CAM and Shapley values to highlight pulmonary opacities and improve clinician trust in deep learning models.

Title: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Hospital Systems
Abstract Note: Collaborative model training without centralizing patient radiological scans preserves privacy while improving diagnostic accuracy.

Title: Transformer Architectures for Lung Segmentation and Diagnosis
Abstract Note: A dual-stage vision transformer performs both anatomical lung field segmentation and consolidation classification.

Title: Data Imbalance Mitigation in Medical Chest X-Ray Datasets
Abstract Note: Addressing severe label skew in rare pulmonary disease classification through synthetic data augmentation and focal loss.

Title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Deep Neural Networks for Neonatal Respiratory Distress
Abstract Note: Evaluation of residual neural networks in low resource pediatric clinical environments for early pneumonia detection.

Title: Ensemble Deep Learning for Multiclass Pulmonary Disease Classification
Abstract Note: Combining ensemble convolutional classifiers with attention mechanisms to distinguish between tuberculosis, pneumonia and normal scans.
